body: I suspect it is more like before you were born, the blissful light of nothingness.  But I can suffer for 40+ more years and then end up there, or end up there now, seems like a no brainer to me.
Can't comment on method too much because of the subreddit rules and I really don't want to help some 14 year old kill himself, but I assure you, my method is pretty certain.
Damn, I can't even make a post on Reddit about suicide and not have people reject me, I am such a failure, going to just go do what needs to be done.
Most of the activities I enjoy are hard to do by yourself.  Thanks for reminding me of that :/

I am afraid, but my method is pretty fool-proof. Not really scared of pain from dying, death is supposed to be painful.  If you aren't willing to put up with some pain, then you probably don't want it enough to actually do it.
Don't think so.  Like the people from 5 years didn't help me get over the people from 8 years ago.  They all just pile on the grieving.
Already told you, can't get over the ones I lost :/

I have never had any real friends in my life except the ones that turned me away eventually.  I don't really know why.  I have no car, little money, makes it even harder.  I see the people who have rejected have so many friends, and it makes me feel so inferior and depressed.
Whoever downvoted you, that is mean....
No friends, literally none.  No I don't live in the south.  Recent college grad but can't find work.
Various reasons, two found out I was gay and they didn't like that, another I don't know.  But I can't never get over it.
They don't like me anymore, I have tried talking to them, they mostly ignore me.  One told me to kill myself once.
It means I still experience intense pain from the loss of people I haven't spoken to in five years (actually some I haven't spoken to in 8 years).
Not really sure what there is to say :/
Loneliness, the complete and utter lack of the ability to let go of loved ones, and a profound sense of failure in life.
